after: Consecutive paragraphs of one quote style join into one blockquote with `>` separator lines; source maps shift with the text and separator lines map to no native paragraph. Planned multi-paragraph block quotes now land through the private direct executor.
reason: Read-only converter output change. It adds no document writes, operations, shared fields, or transport dependencies.
